disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. It does not list every interaction. Always ask a doctor or pharmacist before taking medicines together.

pairs.explanation: Both thin the blood. Taking them together can cause serious bleeding.
Ibuprofen can irritate the stomach and increase the bleeding risk of warfarin.
Metronidazole can make warfarin much stronger and cause serious bleeding.
Amiodarone can raise the warfarin level, leading to bleeding.
Rifampicin can make warfarin stop working, so blood clots may form.

Carbamazepine can make warfarin weaker and raise the risk of a blood clot.
